fortunes.zh: 海面之上是浪，海面之下是路。
fortunes.en: Above the surface, waves; below it, a way.

fortunes.zh: 鲸不追浪，浪自来。
fortunes.en: The whale chases no waves. The waves come.

fortunes.zh: 大音希声，大鲸潜深。
fortunes.en: Great sound is near-silent; great whales dive deep.

fortunes.zh: 你听到的每一声鲸歌，都是深海对浅海的回信。
fortunes.en: Every whale song you hear is the deep answering the shallow.

fortunes.zh: 别怕下潜：压力最大的地方，浮力也最大。
fortunes.en: Dive without fear — the deepest pressure gives the strongest lift.

fortunes.zh: 鲸群从不解释方向，它们只是游成方向。
fortunes.en: The pod never explains its direction. It just swims it.

fortunes.zh: 涨潮时别数脚印，退潮时也别怪沙滩。
fortunes.en: Count no footprints at high tide, blame no sand at low tide.

fortunes.zh: 灯塔不照亮整片海，只照亮你该避开的礁。
fortunes.en: A lighthouse doesn't light the whole sea — only the reef to miss.

fortunes.zh: 盐从不喊咸，海却因它成海。
fortunes.en: Salt never claims to be salty — it just makes the sea.

fortunes.zh: 沉船不是海的错，是船问了海答不了的问题。
fortunes.en: No wreck is the sea's fault — the ship asked what the sea can't answer.

fortunes.zh: 海沟最深处，也最安静。
fortunes.en: The deepest trench is the quietest.

fortunes.zh: 雾再大，看罗盘，别盯雾。
fortunes.en: In the thickest fog, watch the compass, not the fog.

fortunes.zh: 鲸落不是终点，是海底的一场开饭。
fortunes.en: A whale fall isn't the end — it's a feast for the deep.

fortunes.zh: 浮标晃得最凶的地方，水未必最深。
fortunes.en: The buoy that bobs hardest doesn't mark the deepest water.

fortunes.zh: 冰山露给你看的部分，从来不是撞沉你的部分。
fortunes.en: The part of the iceberg you see is never the part that sinks you.

fortunes.zh: 退潮的水洼里，也盛得下自己的月亮。
fortunes.en: Even a tide pool holds its own moon.

fortunes.zh: 别教海水往哪流，选好你站的那条洋流。
fortunes.en: Don't tell the sea where to flow — pick the current you stand in.

fortunes.zh: 海不教鱼怎么游，鱼生来会水。
fortunes.en: The sea doesn't teach fish to swim — they're born to it.

fortunes.zh: 潮汐表不说谎，只在你看得懂时才有用。
fortunes.en: Tide tables never lie — only once you learn to read them.

fortunes.zh: 锚沉到底，船自然停。
fortunes.en: Anchor down, the ship comes to rest.

fortunes.zh: 浪大不是海发火，是风借海说话。
fortunes.en: Big waves aren't anger — the wind speaks through the sea.

fortunes.zh: 退潮带走沙，带不走岸。
fortunes.en: The tide takes the sand, not the shore.

fortunes.zh: 海螺里装着海，贴耳才听得见。
fortunes.en: A seashell holds the sea — press it to your ear.

fortunes.zh: 帆顺风时快，逆风时才知道它值钱。
fortunes.en: A sail is fast downwind — upwind, you learn its worth.

fortunes.zh: 海图再旧，也比船长的记忆准。
fortunes.en: The oldest chart beats the captain's memory.

fortunes.zh: 别在退潮时量海，海没变浅，是你站错了时候。
fortunes.en: Don't measure the sea at low tide — it hasn't shrunk; you timed it wrong.

fortunes.zh: 一只鲸鱼从不问海有多深，它只问往哪游。
fortunes.en: A whale never asks how deep the sea is, only where to swim.

fortunes.zh: 鲸歌是深海的普通话，波浪是它的方言。
fortunes.en: Whale song is the deep's common tongue; the waves, its dialect.

fortunes.zh: 白鲸不是白，是深到发光。
fortunes.en: The white whale isn't white — it's deep enough to glow.

fortunes.zh: 鲸群游过的地方，深海记得。
fortunes.en: Where the pod has swum, the deep remembers.
